---
title: "FACS QC report"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_depth: 4
    toc_float: true
params:
  prep: ""
  exclusions: NULL
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
# Plain-resolution figures: retina PNGs of tall facet grids make the
# self-contained HTML tens of MB.
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.retina = 1, dpi = 96)
prep <- readRDS(params$prep)
info <- prep$info
data <- prep$data
matched <- JanisHelpers::facs_match_exclusions(data, params$exclusions, info$assay)
clashes <- JanisHelpers::facs_check_file_clashes(data)

settings <- JanisHelpers:::qc_settings_(prep)
scored <- JanisHelpers:::qc_score_(data, settings,
                                   excluded_files = matched$excluded_files$file_name)
all_pops <- JanisHelpers:::qc_resolve_(data)$qc_populations
describe_sel <- function(sel, all) {
  if (length(sel) == 0) "none"
  else if (setequal(sel, all)) paste0("all (", length(all), ")")
  else paste(sel, collapse = ", ")
}
or_unset <- function(x) if (is.null(x)) "not set" else paste0("`", x, "`")
conditions <- sort(unique(data$condition))
tissues <- intersect(settings$expected_tissues, unique(data$tissue))

# Print a ggplot (or nothing for NULL) with a height that fits its facet rows.
emit_plot <- function(p) {
  if (is.null(p)) return(invisible(NULL))
  h <- JanisHelpers:::qc_fig_height_(length(unique(p$data$.row)))
  env <- new.env()
  env$p <- p
  # knit_child() switches to the template's folder; switch back afterwards.
  wd <- getwd()
  on.exit(setwd(wd), add = TRUE)
  cat(knitr::knit_child(
    text = c(sprintf("```{r, fig.height = %s, fig.width = 10}", h), "print(p)", "```"),
    envir = env, quiet = TRUE
  ), "\n\n")
}
note <- function(...) cat("\n\n*", ..., "*\n\n", sep = "")
# Returns whether a heading was written (one "none" condition gets none).
condition_heading <- function(cond, level = "####") {
  shown <- length(conditions) > 1 || cond != "none"
  if (shown) cat("\n\n", level, " Condition: ", cond, "\n\n", sep = "")
  invisible(shown)
}

# Individuals plot of one check, per condition.
emit_individuals <- function(check, population = NULL, level = "####") {
  for (cond in conditions) {
    condition_heading(cond, level)
    emit_plot(JanisHelpers:::qc_plot_individuals_(scored, settings, check,
                                                  condition = cond,
                                                  population = population))
  }
}

# Batch plots of one check: one per condition x tissue.
emit_batch <- function(check, population = NULL, level = "#####") {
  if (is.null(settings$batch_col)) {
    note("Batch column not set -- rerun the prep script with `batch_col`.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  for (cond in conditions) {
    tissue_level <- if (condition_heading(cond, level)) paste0(level, "#") else level
    for (tis in tissues) {
      p <- JanisHelpers:::qc_plot_batch_(scored, settings, check, tissue = tis,
                                         condition = cond, population = population)
      if (!is.null(p)) {
        cat("\n\n", tissue_level, " Batch -- ", tis, "\n\n", sep = "")
        emit_plot(p)
      }
    }
  }
}

# Both: individuals, then batch plots (MFI).
emit_check <- function(check, population = NULL) {
  emit_individuals(check, population, level = "#####")
  emit_batch(check, population, level = "#####")
}
```

| | |
|---|---|
| Workspace | `r basename(info$wsp_path)` |
| Root / version | `r info$wsp_root` / `r format(info$wsp_version)` |
| Panel (assay) | `r info$assay` |
| Prep result created | `r format(info$created_at, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")` |
| JanisHelpers | `r info$package_version` |
| Group / batch column | `r or_unset(settings$group_col)` / `r or_unset(settings$batch_col)` |
| QC populations | `r describe_sel(settings$qc_populations, all_pops)` |
| MFI populations / markers | `r describe_sel(settings$qc_mfi_populations, all_pops)` / `r describe_sel(settings$qc_metrics, settings$qc_metrics)` |
| Outlier labels | outside the boxplot whiskers; populations with at least `r settings$min_events` events |

All samples are shown. Rows on the exclusions sheet are only flagged here;
they are dropped at the final export.

## Files

```{r files}
files <- data |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_populations = dplyr::n_distinct(population_full_path),
    .by = c(file_name, mouse_ID, tissue, condition)
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    dplyr::rename(matched$excluded_files, excluded = reason),
    by = "file_name"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(excluded = dplyr::coalesce(excluded, "")) |>
  dplyr::arrange(mouse_ID, tissue, condition)
knitr::kable(files)
```

## Keyword clashes

```{r clashes, results = "asis"}
if (nrow(clashes) == 0) {
  cat("None -- every mouse_ID x tissue x condition comes from one file.\n")
} else {
  cat("**Warning: these files share one mouse_ID x tissue x condition.**",
      "Fix the keywords in FlowJo; the final export refuses until then.\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(clashes))
}
```

## Exclusions

```{r exclusions, results = "asis"}
if (nrow(matched$applicable) == 0) {
  cat("No exclusions apply to this panel.\n")
} else {
  print(knitr::kable(matched$applicable))
}
ex <- params$exclusions
if (!is.null(ex) && nrow(ex) > 0 && "panel" %in% names(ex)) {
  other <- ex[!is.na(ex$panel) & as.character(ex$panel) != info$assay, ]
  if (nrow(other) > 0) {
    cat("\n\n### Rows for other panels (ignored here)\n\n",
        "Check the panel name if one of these was meant for '", info$assay,
        "'.\n\n", sep = "")
    print(knitr::kable(other))
  }
}
if (nrow(matched$unmatched) > 0) {
  cat("\n\n### Warning: these rows match no file\n\n",
      "Check for typos -- the final export stops on them.\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(matched$unmatched))
}
```

## QC checks

Outlier labels: every point outside its boxplot's whiskers (more than
1.5 x IQR beyond the quartiles, on the plot's axis), within group x tissue x
population. Not labelled: populations under `r settings$min_events` events
(they still count towards the box). Excluded samples are drawn and count
towards the box like the others; the flag table marks them.

```{r no-group, results = "asis"}
if (is.null(settings$group_col)) {
  note("Group column not set -- rerun the prep script with `group_col` to score outliers.")
}
```

### Completeness

```{r completeness, results = "asis"}
comp <- JanisHelpers:::qc_completeness_(data, settings)
if (is.null(comp)) {
  note("Expected mice not set -- rerun the prep script with `expected_mice`.")
} else {
  cat(comp$n_expected, " expected samples, ", comp$n_present, " present.\n\n", sep = "")
  if (nrow(comp$missing) == 0) {
    cat("None missing.\n")
  } else {
    print(knitr::kable(comp$missing, caption = "Missing samples"))
  }
}
```

### Empty values and missing stats

Empty (`NA`) values usually come from a calculation without inputs (e.g.
`count_per_g` for a tissue without weight / volumes in the meta workbook);
they are exported as empty rows. Filter them out in `prepare()` if the
metric isn't wanted for that tissue.

```{r empty-values, results = "asis"}
empty <- JanisHelpers:::qc_empty_values_(data)
n_empty <- sum(empty$n_empty)
n_no_events <- sum(empty$n_no_events)
cat("\n\n#### Empty values\n\n")
cat(n_empty, " of ", nrow(data), " values empty (",
    round(100 * n_empty / nrow(data), 1), "%)", sep = "")
if (n_no_events > 0) {
  cat(", ", n_no_events, " of them in populations with 0 events (expected)", sep = "")
}
cat(". \"absent\" = metric not calculated for that tissue.\n\n")
bad <- empty[empty$status %in% c("all empty", "partly empty"), ]
if (nrow(bad) > 0) {
  cat("**Warning: empty values for ",
      paste0(bad$metric, " (", bad$tissue,
             ifelse(length(conditions) > 1, paste0(" / ", bad$condition), ""),
             ")", collapse = ", "),
      ".**\n\n", sep = "")
}
print(knitr::kable(JanisHelpers:::qc_empty_grid_(empty),
                   caption = "Values per metric x tissue"))

cat("\n\n#### Missing stats\n\n")
missing_stats <- JanisHelpers:::qc_missing_stats_(data)
if (nrow(missing_stats) == 0) {
  cat("None -- every file has all populations x metrics of its tissue.\n")
} else {
  cat("**Warning: these gates / statistics exist only in some files of the",
      "tissue** (gate or statistic not applied to all samples in FlowJo?).\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(missing_stats))
}

cat("\n\n#### Keywords\n\n")
dropped <- info$dropped_files
if (is.null(dropped)) {
  note("Files dropped for missing keywords not recorded (prep saved by an older JanisHelpers).")
} else if (nrow(dropped) == 0) {
  cat("No files dropped -- every file has `mouse_ID` and `tissue`.\n\n")
} else {
  cat(nrow(dropped), " file(s) dropped for a missing `mouse_ID` / `tissue`",
      " keyword. Compensation / FMO files are expected here; check the rest.\n\n",
      sep = "")
  print(knitr::kable(dropped))
}
empty_kw <- JanisHelpers:::qc_empty_keywords_(data, settings)
if (nrow(empty_kw) > 0) {
  cat("\n\n**Warning: empty group / batch values** (check the meta workbook).\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(empty_kw))
} else if (!is.null(settings$group_col) || !is.null(settings$batch_col)) {
  cat("\n\nNo empty group / batch values.\n")
}
```

### Fraction of parent

Gating hierarchy: each population as a fraction of its parent.

```{r hierarchy, results = "asis"}
emit_individuals("hierarchy")
```

### Raw counts

```{r counts, results = "asis"}
emit_individuals("counts")
```

### Batch effects

#### Fraction of parent

```{r batch-hierarchy, results = "asis"}
emit_batch("hierarchy")
```

#### Raw counts

```{r batch-counts, results = "asis"}
emit_batch("counts")
```

### MFI

```{r mfi, results = "asis"}
if (length(settings$qc_mfi_populations) == 0) {
  note("No MFI populations selected (`qc_mfi_populations` in the prep script).")
} else {
  for (pop in settings$qc_mfi_populations) {
    cat("\n\n#### ", pop, "\n\n", sep = "")
    if (!any(scored$check == "mfi" & as.character(scored$population) == pop)) {
      note("No MFI values for this population.")
      next
    }
    emit_check("mfi", population = pop)
  }
}
```

### Flagged samples

```{r flags, results = "asis"}
if (is.null(settings$group_col)) {
  note("Not scored -- group column not set.")
} else {
  flags <- JanisHelpers:::qc_flag_table_(scored, settings)
  if (nrow(flags) == 0) {
    cat("No samples flagged.\n")
  } else {
    cat("Score = number of distinct tissue x condition x check combinations",
        "flagged for the mouse; every flagged value is listed.\n\n")
    flags$value <- signif(flags$value, 3)
    flags$box_median <- signif(flags$box_median, 3)
    flags$excluded <- ifelse(flags$excluded, "excluded", "")
    print(knitr::kable(flags))
  }
}
```
